{{Quote|I think we're on farmland. And where there's a farm, there's usually a farmer. Let's find his homestead.|[[Jesse/Legends|CT-5597]]|<ref name="Deserter" />}}
The '''Lawquane farmstead'''<ref name="TCW Magazine">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 18|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 18]]</ref> was a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], within the planet's wetland region. The home of the [[Lawquane family/Legends|Lawquane family]]—comprised of former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]], his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] wife [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu]], and their two children, [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]]—the farm enjoyed lush soil and good weather, contributing to a fertile growth of crops. The Lawquane farmstead was also home to a herd of [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], which the family raised for [[Milk/Legends|milk]] and meat, and kept as beasts of burden. During the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the farm and the Lawquane family were drawn into a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|battle]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] when an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] filled with damaged [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] was activated in the nearby fields. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were repelled by the combined efforts of Cut Lawquane and his temporary guest, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], saving his family and protecting the farm.

==Layout==
{{Quote|There are some benches out back in the barn.|[[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]]|<ref name="Deserter" />}}
[[File:Lawquane_farmhouse.png|thumb|left|200px|The Lawquanes' farmhouse at night]]
The Lawquane [[Farm/Legends|farmstead's]] central feature was the main farmhouse, an unattractive mix of [[Wood/Legends|wood]], [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts, and other assorted material that had been scavenged for its construction.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Nearby was a barn used to house the farm's [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], and outside, a corral for containing the herd.<ref name="Deserter" /> The [[Lawquane family/Legends|Lawquane family]] raised these hardy beasts for their [[Milk/Legends|milk]], meat, and hides, in addition to keeping them as beasts of burden for use around the farm. On the farthest reaches of the farmstead were the agricultural fields, where the family grew their crops in the lush soil and good weather afforded by [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami's]] wetland region.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

==History==
{{Quote|We want no trouble here.|Suu Lawquane|<ref name="Deserter" />}}
[[File:LawquaneFamilyTD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Cut Lawquane prepares to defend his family and farm.]]
Following his desertion from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] after a disastrous battle with the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Saleucami, the former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut]] fell in love with a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] by the name of [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]]. The two were [[Marriage/Legends|married]] and Cut adopted Suu's two children, [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]], becoming a family.<ref name="Deserter" /> Together, they made the modest farm their home, and made a good life for themselves growing crops and raising eopies. Far from the front lines of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the family enjoyed the peaceful evenings their farm home provided.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

The peace they enjoyed would be threatened by the arrival of Confederacy forces under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. After suffering a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|loss]] against the Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] in Saleucami's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Grievous and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] made planetfall in a number of [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. One heavily damaged pod crashed on the outskirts of the Lawquane farmstead, where it and its [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droid]] occupants were accidentally activated by Shaeeah Lawquane. As the [[Commando/Legends|commando]]-series [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] turned on the farmhouse, Cut took up [[Blaster/Legends|arms]] to protect his family and home with the assistance of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]—known informally as "Rex". Previously injured by another commando droid, Rex had been given refuge at the Lawquane farmstead while his wound healed. Now under attack, the two clones fought and destroyed the droids, keeping Lawquane and his family safe, and avoiding more than minimal damage to the farmhouse. Rex left the farm to rejoin [[Torrent Company/Legends|his unit]] the following morning, deciding against turning Cut Lawquane in as a deserter.<ref name="Deserter" />
